random-words 2.0.1 (word list only)
Licence: MIT (see LICENSE.txt)
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/random-words
        https://github.com/apostrophecms/random-words
Package file: https://registry.npmjs.org/random-words/-/random-words-2.0.1.tgz

words.txt holds the 1,952 words of the `wordList` array exported by the
package's index.js, one word per line, in the package's order and unchanged.
The generator code of the package is not used. The typing test page
(/typing-test/) loads this file when its "Common words" mode is chosen.
